scope: Proposition 5.2 (Simplicity with the eigenfunction fixed) of the manuscript “Smooth counterexamples to Yau's nodal upper bound in dimensions three and four” (preprints/Smooth-counterexamples-to-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-in-dimensions-three-and-four-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e4c129bdb0f2f45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 29-30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h be a smooth metric on S3 and let u be a nonzero real smooth function satisfying −∆hu = Λnu, Λn = n(n + 2), n ≥ 2. 29 Suppose that, on an annulus A = {a < r < b} with 0 < a < b < 1, one has h = g∗ and u = wn. In every C∞ neighborhood of h there is a smooth metric h′ such that h′ − h is supported compactly in A, dVh′ = dVh, −∆h′ u = Λnu, and Λn is a simple eigenvalue of −∆h′ .
